A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the helical capsid protein of Newcastle Disease virus was purified from Escherichi coli using a packed‐bed anion exchange chromatographic process.

a packed bed anion exchanger (PB‐AEX) was used to purifiy a truncated version of NDV nucleocapsid (NP) protein, NPΔc375, from clarified feedstock and the results were compared with those from the same protein purified by a conventional batch anion exchanger.
a packed bed anion exchanger (SepFastTM SuporQ) is capable of purifying NPΔc375 to 76.7%.
The main takeaway from our work is that

we have demonstrated the use of a packed bed anion‐exchange chromatography (PB AEC) for the purification of a truncated version of nucleocapsid (NP) protein of Newcastle disease Virus (NDV) expressed in Escherichia Coli.
PB‐AEC can efficiently purify the long helical capsids of NDV from clarified feedstock with high purity and yield.
the SepFastTM Supo Q pre‐packed columns could be used for the purification of the long helical capsids of Newcastle disease virus.
